description: The FULL report behind a CreatorScore — what the brand dashboard shows, for a creator you've already scored: every active risk flag WITH its evidence (post link, caption/transcript excerpt, on-screen text, the reviewer's reasoning, links to the archived thumbnail + flagged frame), brand mentions with a disclosure verdict per brand (undisclosed partnerships = FTC exposure), controversy summary + web findings, SHAP score drivers per agent, audience demographics, following-graph risk, full score history, engagement, narrative — plus a browser-openable PDF link the user can share. Covers the WHOLE footprint from any one handle. INCLUDED (free) for a creator this account already paid to score; 1 credit as a cached read otherwise; never scrapes. If there is no score yet, use score_creator_footprint first. Use this whenever the user asks WHY a score is what it is, wants to see the flags, asks about brand deals/disclosure, or needs a report for a meeting.

platform.description: Platform of ANY one of the creator's accounts.

name: get_creator_report
